O.outcome_detail: out-of-school suspension rate among middle school girls

cells.quote: In the 2011–12 school year, 12% of middle school girls in OUSD were suspended from school; by 2018, that number had fallen to 6%.
cells.note: The study reports a longitudinal before–after comparison based on Ed Trust calculations; no randomized comparison or printed standardized effect size is reported.

O.outcome_detail: out-of-school suspension rate among high school girls

cells.quote: In that same time frame, the percentage of high school girls suspended fell from 8% to 5%.
cells.note: The study reports a longitudinal before–after comparison based on Ed Trust calculations; no randomized comparison or printed standardized effect size is reported.

O.outcome_detail: out-of-school suspension rate among high school girls

cells.quote: In the 2011–12 school year, 12% of middle school girls in OUSD were suspended from school; by 2018, that number had fallen to 6%. In that same time frame, the percentage of high school girls suspended fell from 8% to 5%.
cells.note: The study reports a before–after district comparison without a randomized or controlled design; no formal effect size is printed.

O.outcome_detail: 11th-grade school connectedness, safety, belonging, happiness, and perceived teacher fairness

cells.quote: Some of these changes are substantial, with more students reporting they feel happy and safe in their school, and more students feeling teachers treat them fairly.
cells.note: The study compares California Healthy Kids Survey responses from 2009–10 and 2017–18; it reports percentages but no formal effect size or statistical test.

cells.quote: Over the last 10 years, there have been a number of positive policy changes and practice adjustments that have decreased school push out for students of color in Chicago Public Schools (CPS). As a result, the number of CPS out-of-school suspensions has dropped.
cells.note: The study provides a narrative before–after account for Chicago, without numerical results or a formal effect size.
